probe.scope: synthetic disposable fixtures; no target repository, real secret or external network

summary.verified_scope: macOS Seatbelt filesystem default-deny least-privilege read policy (R-01, R-05), unconditional network egress denial (R-03), cryptographic command binding and ExecutionSpec attestation (R-02, R-07, A2), cross-process persistent replay prevention via thread/file-locked ApprovalStore (R-07, A1), raw command argument telemetry sanitization (R-07), incremental stream bounding with process group termination (R-04), unconditional descendant process group cleanup in finally (R-06, A3), and fail-closed platform checks
summary.not_verified_scope: production containers/VMs, external egress L7 proxy, multi-tenant cloud agent isolation

matrix.requirement: R-04 output bounding: process group terminated when max_bytes exceeded without memory explosion
matrix.actual: output_truncated=True; exit_code=-9 (SIGKILL); stdout_bytes <= 256

matrix.requirement: R-04 timeout enforcement: process group killed within finite wall-clock limit

matrix.actual: PermissionError / Operation not permitted; /etc/passwd and host paths blocked

matrix.requirement: R-06 process lifecycle: session process group killed unconditionally in finally
matrix.expected: exit_code=0; no surviving descendant or background processes
matrix.actual: exit_code=0; grandchild process terminated via SIGKILL in finally

matrix.requirement: R-06 orphan prevention: detached child exiting does not leak grandchild process
matrix.expected: grandchild PID raises OSError ESRCH after adapter execution
matrix.actual: grandchild PID dead immediately after adapter dispatch returns

matrix.requirement: R-07 approval integrity: ApprovalStore prevents replay across fresh adapter instances
matrix.actual: second instance dispatch blocked=True; occurred=False (authorization replay rejected)

matrix.expected: concurrent attempts to consume same approval key allow exactly 1 success
matrix.actual: atomic check-and-consume succeeds once, concurrent attempts raise/block

matrix.requirement: R-07 execution spec binding: ExecutionSpec constructed before request and spec_sha256 attested
matrix.expected: attestation validates spec_sha256; mismatched spec rejected
matrix.actual: spec_sha256 validated; mismatched spec blocked=True

matrix.requirement: R-07 telemetry privacy: command arguments redacted from telemetry events

matrix.requirement: A1 replay prevention: separate host processes cannot reuse consumed authorizations

matrix.requirement: A3 POSIX containment boundary: setsid() session escape documented as unsupported on macOS Seatbelt
matrix.expected: setsid() escape demonstrated and documented; fail-closed boundary enforced
matrix.actual: setsid() escapes saved_pgid; limitation documented; multi-tenant requires microVM/container

not_tested: production Docker, container, VM or microVM isolation
limitations: Non-macOS environments fail closed (blocked=True), preserving static-only mode.
Arbitrary code execution on multi-tenant production systems requires external OCI containers or microVMs.
